answer_1.quote: In this paper, we explore the task of providing open-ended feedback to improve story writing.

answer_2.quote: We run several automatic metrics on the generated feedback to describe the output and evaluate its quality.

answer_4.quote: Participants annotated 1,920 pieces of feedback... We collected 3 human annotations for each piece of feedback.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators responded to questions along multiple dimensions of quality... including sanity-check, feedback-type, perfect-agree, correctness, error-detection, specificity, relevance.
